eval_cases.question: Can I book Business Class for a 4-hour flight from Dublin to Zurich?
eval_cases.expected_answer: No. Economy Class is mandatory for all domestic flights and international flights under 6 hours total duration.
key_policy_rules: Section 2.1 - Short-haul flights under 6 hours require Economy Class.

eval_cases.question: Under what conditions am I allowed to fly Business Class or First Class for international travel?
eval_cases.expected_answer: Business Class is permissible for direct, non-stop international flights exceeding 6 hours with VP approval. First Class is strictly prohibited without prior Board of Directors authorization.
key_policy_rules: Section 2.1 - Business class requires >6h flight and VP approval; First class requires Board approval.

eval_cases.question: Can I expense in-room movies or mini-bar snacks charged to my hotel bill?
eval_cases.expected_answer: No. Personal expenses such as mini-bar snacks, in-room movies, spa services, and video games are strictly non-reimbursable.
key_policy_rules: Section 4.0 - Personal in-room entertainment and mini-bar expenses are non-reimbursable.
